name: US FTC: AI claims evidence / AI 宣传证据 (draft)
description: Selected advertising-substantiation evidence requests for AI product claims. Enforcement examples inform review; they are not universal technical requirements.

sources.title: FTC Policy Statement Regarding Advertising Substantiation
FTC Workado AI detection claims enforcement announcement

limitations: Draft supporting checklist under existing consumer-protection principles, not a standalone US AI Act, complete FTC compliance or legal determination.
The policy statement explains substantiation principles; a case-specific order is not a general rule for all companies. This pack does not import proposed AI policy statements as binding law.
Excludes state AI/privacy laws, employment, credit, healthcare, federal procurement and other sectoral rules.
Evidence availability and assessment booleans are supplied claims, not independent verification. The 30-day freshness limit is local assurance policy, not an FTC-mandated interval.

controls.title: Review jurisdiction and advertising context
controls.remediation: Record jurisdiction, audience and the objective claims being assessed.

controls.title: Versioned claims inventory available
controls.citation: FTC substantiation policy: reasonable basis; supporting practice
controls.remediation: Link published AI capability and accuracy claims to the advertised product version.

controls.title: Pre-publication substantiation record available
controls.citation: FTC substantiation policy: prior substantiation; evidence support
controls.remediation: Reference evidence held before dissemination; later tests do not establish prior substantiation.

controls.title: Review claims and evidentiary adequacy
controls.citation: FTC substantiation policy: reasonable basis and prior substantiation
controls.remediation: Review express/implied claims and whether evidence supports the advertised scope; narrow unsupported promises.
